程序包 org.bukkit.metadata

类 FixedMetadataValue

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.metadata.MetadataValueAdapter

org.bukkit.metadata.FixedMetadataValue
所有已实现的接口:
MetadataValue
public class FixedMetadataValue extends LazyMetadataValue
A FixedMetadataValue is a special case metadata item that contains the same value forever after initialization. Invalidating a FixedMetadataValue has no effect. FixedMetadataValue 是一种特殊的元数据项，初始化后永远包含相同的值。使 FixedMetadataValue 失效没有任何效果。

This class extends LazyMetadataValue for historical reasons, even though it overrides all the implementation methods. it is possible that in the future that the inheritance hierarchy may change.

此类出于历史原因继承了 LazyMetadataValue，尽管它重写了所有实现方法。将来其继承层级有可能发生变化。
